label: EU-mdr-2017 Article 103

obligations.text: Each Member State shall appoint to the MDCG, for a three-year term which may be renewed, one member and one alternate each with expertise in the field of medical devices, and one member and one alternate with expertise in the field of in vitro diagnostic medical devices.
The members of the MDCG shall be chosen for their competence and experience in the field of medical devices and in vitro diagnostic medical devices.
They shall represent the competent authorities of the Member States.
The names and affiliation of members shall be made public by the Commission.
The alternates shall represent and vote for the members in their absence.
The MDCG shall meet at regular intervals and, where the situation requires, upon request by the Commission or a Member State.

The meetings shall be attended either by the members appointed for their role and expertise in the field of medical devices, or by the members appointed for their expertise in the field of in vitro diagnostic medical devices, or by the members appointed for their expertise in both fields, or their alternates, as appropriate.
The MDCG shall use its best endeavours to reach consensus.
If such consensus cannot be reached, the MDCG shall decide by a majority of its members.
The MDCG shall be chaired by a representative of the Commission.
The chair shall not take part in votes of the MDCG.

Where appropriate, organisations representing the interests of the medical device industry, healthcare professionals, laboratories, patients and consumers at Union level shall be invited to such sub-groups in the capacity of observers.
The MDCG shall have the tasks laid down in Article 105 of this Regulation and Article 99 of Regulation (EU) 2017/746.
